rationale: The win condition now depends on play, and this is the file balance/README.md said should move when it landed. THE CONSTANT: one, ascension-institutions = 2, a conjunct of BOTH paths -- apotheosisSatisfied every tick, eraBoundaryPassed at every era boundary Path B counts. Identity value 0 reproduces the shipped predicate. No other constant, cap or magnitude touched. MEASURED DELTAS, all ten inside tolerance at k=3, largest 1.55 SE: referenceKnowledgeInstances 3266.59 -> 4016.63 (+750.031, 1.55 SE); referencePopulation and referencePopulationChange each +2134.16 (1.48 SE); referenceNodesKnown and referenceNodesGained each +8.1875 (0.73 SE); referenceNodesGainedFinalQuarter 4.875 -> 3.21875 (-0.78 SE); referenceGrimoires 283.563 -> 255.219 (-0.64 SE); referenceLibraryDepth 34.125 -> 37.5625 (0.52 SE); referenceLivingMages +1.6875 (0.01 SE); referencePeakPopulation 29490 -> 29490, exactly zero. THE MECHANISM, proven not inferred: in a paired re-run at these coordinates, snapshotHash is BIT-IDENTICAL across the two arms for all 40 paired runs each of passive-control, idle-then-declare, denial-warden, narrow-depth, portal-rush and worship-maximizer. The conjunct changes nothing for a universe that was never going to qualify. What changed is permissive-breadth, 40/40 before and 0/40 after, whose 4 runs now play to the 2400-tick cap instead of ending near 1094; a longer run accumulates more of every stock, which is the sign of every delta and why peak population, a max, moved by exactly zero. FOUR TOLERANCES ARE NOW WIDER AND THIS GATE IS LESS SENSITIVE ON THEM: referenceKnowledgeInstances 1455.70 -> 2235.54, referenceNodesKnown and referenceNodesGained 33.44 -> 45.05, referenceLibraryDepth 19.95 -> 24.30. NO TOLERANCE WAS SET: tolerance = standardError x toleranceK, toleranceK is 3 here and in the file this supersedes, and the flag was never passed. The cause is genuinely grown variance -- four of 32 runs stopped terminating early, so the spread grew -- and six other tolerances NARROWED in the same pass, which widening-for-comfort does not produce. The consequence is real regardless of the cause: a future regression in knowledge instances must be half again as large to trip this gate. THE REMEDY IS REPLICATES, NOT A TOLERANCE EDIT: standard error falls with the square root of the sample, so raising replicates in balance-gate-ascension.sweep.json tightens these without touching toleranceK. DEFERRED DELIBERATELY: w69/grant-budget, w70/opening-square, w77/effect-displacement and w80/research-cost-variation each invalidate every committed baseline, and w80 bears hardest on exactly these four metrics -- researchCost is a pure function of tier, all 300 nodes carrying six distinct values with none deviating, so compareTargets' cost key is entirely the node-id tiebreak and giving cost variance changes the discovery curve these measure. The replicate increase belongs in the re-baselining those force, where it costs one run instead of two.
